headline: Guardrail sweep is 50 PASS / 3 FAIL / 1 NO-DATA, from 15 red at the start of the day, and no error-severity gate fails. Of the 4 left, 2 are blocked on Adrian (check-figma-drift and 5 of check-link-integrity's doc-refs both wait on the first figma/snapshot.json, #236), 1 is a deliberate divergence (Tooltip), and 1 is real design work (17 components reading a primitive token with no semantic alias — a design-system call, not a gate repair). Almost nothing red was a code defect. The recurring shape: a gate measuring something that had moved. The docs gate read 11 doc-site pages ADR-018 deleted, so 0 of 104 was arithmetic, not coverage. check-validator-wiring read a ci.yml COMMENT as CI wiring — 7 of its 8 drifts were that one comment, and the registry it accused was correct. check-motion did not know Tailwind `transition-colors`, so it called Tag motionless while Tag animates. check-token-paths-ratchet was reading a derivation bug: the hds.* bridge's aliases (space.px4 is --primitive-space-1) were passed through as if they were primitive keys. Three gates were auditing spec files, reporting the literals a test exists to pin. And exemption markers were invisible whenever their reason wrapped onto a second line, so the advice was to write the marker already sitting there.
next: 17 check-tier-bypass violations: components reading var(--primitive-*) directly. Each needs a decision — does a semantic alias exist, should one be created, or is the primitive right? The only remaining red that is actual design-system work

#249 — gate the record artifacts: a pre-push check so status.json and .changeset cannot silently go stale (5 changesets pending, CHANGELOG last touched 2026-07-10). The api-baseline was 81 commits stale for the same reason
68 baselined check-token-paths-ratchet violations remain (down from 72). Burn down via unit 12g
Tooltip (93:15) is the last unmapped Figma asset, on purpose: Figma publishes a Tooltip component, the code Tooltip is an @internal image-hover utility. Rename one side or accept the divergence

The manifest's consumer scanner counts a component NAME IN A COMMENT as a dependency — the same comment-blindness fixed in check-validator-wiring and check-token-paths-ratchet this session. Not chased; it produced one false edge and was worked around
The push/drift/snapshot machinery (1441 lines, 89 tests) is complete and correct but has never run against Figma. Do not cut it — run the first push, then decide what earns its keep
ADR-025 states the Figma variables were 'edited by hand'. They were not: they were generated by the figma-agent-plugin sync-tokens tool, archived on archive/figma-bridge by ADR-018. Filed as #250
blocked: Adrian: #236 — commit the first figma/snapshot.json. Import figma/push/plugin/manifest.json in Figma desktop, run "Plan push (dry run)" against the COPY (qhlYOkWPKs8MfO3x1M5W4f) not the published library, then Take snapshot. This unblocks TWO gates: check-figma-drift (NO-DATA) and check-link-integrity's 5 remaining doc-refs. Read the plan before pushing: the variables were generated by an older tool of ours, so the first push reconciles two generations, not hand-work against automation
Adrian: #235 — ratify or redline the core/pattern/internal/fold disposition table. Default applies 2026-10-03 if unanswered

Adrian: #126 — CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN in Actions secrets + CHROMATIC_ENABLED=true in Actions variables. The build is verified green, so this cannot fail on code. Re-claimed by the loop 8 times with the same blocker; marked do-not-re-dispatch

Adrian: #199 — release is held by an org-level policy, not a repo setting. GitHub org hirobius -> Settings -> Actions -> General -> Workflow permissions -> Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests. Nothing publishes past 0.13.0 until this is ticked

Adrian: two community UI kits (Material 3 Design Kit, Simple Design System) are subscribed to the HDS Figma file, so every design-system search returns their components alongside ours. Figma -> Assets panel -> book icon -> toggle both off
